methodology.first_call: After jax.clear_caches(); includes tracing/compilation and execution. Existing persistent disk caches may still be reused.
methodology.warm_latency: Sequential calls; every output leaf blocks before stopping the clock. Warmup calls are excluded from repeat summaries.
methodology.included: Public API validation, dispatch, device execution, synchronization; NumPy input handling/transfers in eager paths.
methodology.excluded: Imports, backend initialization, fixture creation, orbit caching, device-input preparation, output validation and report serialization.
methodology.dynamic_arguments: Observation duration T, epoch t0, parameters, cached positions; BW, format and window shape are static.
methodology.batch_order: Contiguous disjoint catalogue slices, cycling across repeats; amortized per-source latency is batch latency divided by batch size.
methodology.scope: Waveform APIs and A/E derivatives; no likelihood, sampler, or C baseline.
